name: Runtime License Admission V1
purpose: Prevent EGA V9 governed execution unless a valid active Evaluation or Commercial License is admitted.
admissionFlow: Read the locally stored License Key automatically.
Load the official EGA V9 License Public Key.
Verify the License Key signature and payload.
Evaluate the License against the current runtime clock.
Deny an expired Evaluation License at Day 90 or later.
Fail closed for missing, corrupt, forged, unsupported, or invalid licenses.
securityRules: Runtime admission must execute before governed execution begins.
A missing License Key must never silently enable execution.
An invalid signature must never fall back to Evaluation mode.
The runtime clock must be injectable only for tests.
Customer prompts, tool arguments, and execution payloads must not be included in admission errors.
Metering failure and License Admission failure are separate concerns.
